nameEn: Manufacture of pesticides and other agrochemical products
description: This class includes the manufacture of pesticides and other agrochemical products.
includes: manufacture of insecticides, rodenticides, fungicides, herbicides
manufacture of anti-sprouting products, plant growth regulators
excludes: manufacture of fertilizers and nitrogen compounds, see 2012
manufacture of soap and detergents for non-agricultural use, see 2023
